reviews.title: Subscription
reviews.text: I’m only giving this a 1 star because I’ve clicked “cancel membership” multiple times through settings. It switches back to home page. It keeps trying to charge $60. I’ve been trying to cancel this membership for months!! Please don’t sign up for a membership through this app. Everrr!

reviews.title: Doesn’t Work
reviews.text: I just purchased this due to all the raving reviews. I’m really struggling in my Chemistry class. Paid $60.00 for an app that doesn’t work. Anytime I try scanning a question to get an answer, it just buffers and will not load any answers. Super annoying for how expensive this app is. So disappointed.

reviews.title: Quizlet or any other resource would be better
reviews.text: If I could rate it a 0 I would I used this once before added my financial information it continued to charge me in small increments for over a year! I hop back on and think well maybe I could use it one last time before canceling and nope they add another F’n paywall! Screw this app and the producers of it

reviews.title: Doesn’t work properly.
reviews.text: It takes such a long time to load my answer. Sometimes it even gets my math wrong and can’t solve graphs. I wouldn’t recommend this app.
